tradition_assertions.notes: Reviewed work/title crosswalk: the Church's numbered list names Malachi; TAU's index uses the Latinized form Malachias and its book-specific page identifies the Ethiopic Book of Malachi. This is a title/work match only; the historical witness, current edition identity, transcription accuracy, and completeness remain unverified. British Library Add MS 16189's catalog lists the Twelve Prophets in this Ge'ez codex at folios 42v–64v and names a starting folio for each. This is manuscript-catalog evidence only; it does not verify a transcription, complete book boundaries, or identity with a particular current Church edition. Standard USFM title-candidate research readers are catalogued for Malachi.

coverage.structure_description: Four retained TAU text pages yield 55 sequential displayed labels with nonempty bodies (14, 17, 18, 6), plus an explicitly unnumbered doxological close on page 4. This establishes only the inventory of the captured TAU pages, not print or manuscript completeness.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: Geʽez content and source punctuation are retained after whitespace normalization. Four source-page files preserve extraction context; the separate unnumbered closing remains attached to the reader as a continuation. Images and critical apparatus are excluded.
coverage.numbering_policy: Preserve chapter pages 1–4 and displayed labels exactly; keep the actual external target Mal per unit. No verse alignment with the three-chapter Greek-based Brenton companion is inferred.
